title: Marigold — Free Bootstrap 6 Wedding Website Template
excerpt: A free two-page Bootstrap 6 wedding template — countdown, day schedule, gift list and an RSVP that handles a whole party, each guest with their own meal choice and dietary note.
yoastTitle: Marigold — Free Bootstrap 6 Wedding Website Template
yoastDesc: Free Bootstrap 6 wedding website template with a party RSVP handling multiple named guests with individual meal choices, a day schedule timeline, countdown, gift list, gallery and a travel and accommodation page with FAQ.
intro: Marigold is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 wedding website template. It pairs a full wedding homepage — countdown, the couple's story, a schedule for the day, gallery, gift list and RSVP — with a travel and accommodation page carrying directions, taxi numbers, where to stay and an FAQ.
note: Almost every wedding template ships an RSVP that handles one person, so a family of four either submits it four times or gives up and emails — and the couple reconciles a spreadsheet either way. This one takes a party: each named guest gets their own attendance answer, main course and dietary note, added and removed on the page up to eight. Guest blocks are cloned from a <template> rather than built from strings, so they can be restyled without touching JavaScript, and field names are re-indexed on every add so a normal form POST arrives as a usable array rather than four fields sharing a name.
summary: Marigold is a free, premium two-page Bootstrap 6 wedding template. The homepage runs a full-viewport photographic hero with the couple's names and a quiet days-hours-minutes countdown, their story, a seven-item schedule for the day set as a timeline, a photo mosaic, a party RSVP and an honest gift list. The RSVP is the centrepiece: add up to eight named guests, each with their own attendance radio, main-course Combobox and dietary note, with unique field ids and indexed names throughout. The travel page adds directions, transport times, taxi numbers, four places to stay and a native details FAQ covering children, dress, accessibility and dietary requirements. Soft warm design with a display serif and hairline rules. ESM-only vanilla JavaScript, no build step, full light and dark mode.
features: Two pages — wedding homepage and a travel & stay page
Party RSVP: up to eight named guests, each with attendance, meal and dietary note
Guest blocks cloned from a <template>, restylable without touching JavaScript
Field names re-indexed on add, so a form POST arrives as a usable array
First guest cannot be removed; add button disables at the party limit
Unique ids generated per block so every label still points at its own control
Day schedule as a seven-item timeline with times
Quiet countdown reading its date from data-countdown, aria-live off by design
Travel page with transport times, taxi numbers, accommodation and a details FAQ
Bootstrap 6 vendored at a pinned commit, ESM-only, no build step
